method_summary: Frozen Xiaomi-Robotics-1-RoboCasa365 backbone (5B params: Qwen3-VL-4B VLM + 36-layer DiT action head reading the VLM's own KV-cache) fine-tuned with rank-4 LoRA adapters on the VLM's language_model attention/MLP layers only, plus Phasor's own sparse end-to-end memory core (ImprovedHGRNGate + ModernHopfieldLayer + adaptive gate) applied to pooled VLM hidden states as an additive consolidation-loss regularizer. The DiT action head is never modified -- verified on every training run via exact weight-sum matching before/after (87388.32329446077, unchanged in all runs).
training_data: Real RoboCasa365 training data (NVIDIA PhysicalAI-Robotics-Manipulation-Kitchen-Demos, lerobot format), restricted to the 34 official atomic_seen + composite_seen tasks used by the target50 eval protocol. composite_unseen tasks are correctly absent from training data by design (they are the held-out generalization split).

baseline_frozen_xr1.description: Frozen Xiaomi-Robotics-1-RoboCasa365, no fine-tuning -- reference point.

lora_plus_m7_realdata_fixed.description: LoRA + M7 memory-core consolidation, fine-tuned on real RoboCasa365 data. This is the primary submission leg.
lora_plus_m7_realdata_fixed.note: Real, final, complete result (2500/2500 episodes, 0 errors). LoRA+M7 is essentially tied with the frozen baseline on atomic_seen and modestly behind on composite_seen/composite_unseen/overall -- it does NOT clearly beat the baseline in this run. Full per-task composite_unseen breakdown investigated separately: 3 tasks (GatherTableware, HeatKebabSandwich, PanTransfer) score ~0% for BOTH baseline and LoRA+M7 (pre-existing model-family limitation, not a fine-tuning regression); excluding those 3 known-broken tasks would raise both baseline's and LoRA+M7's composite_unseen averages roughly in parallel, not change the relative comparison materially.

lora_only_realdata_fixed.description: LoRA-only ablation leg (no M7 consolidation term), same real RoboCasa365 data and same action-order fix applied. Needed to isolate M7's specific contribution beyond LoRA alone. Auto-launched by queue_lora_only_fixed.sh once lora_plus_m7_realdata_fixed's sweep completed; smoke-tested 15/15 (100%) before the full sweep was launched.
lora_only_realdata_fixed.note: Just started -- too early for a partial readout to be meaningful. Will be updated with final numbers once complete.

lora_only_realdata_INVALID.description: An earlier LoRA-only run on real RoboCasa365 data was affected by the same action-dimension field-order bug documented below and was abandoned early (487/2500 episodes, 1.4% success). Not usable as a comparison point; superseded by lora_only_realdata_fixed above.

training_config.lora_target_modules: VLM language_model attention (q_proj/k_proj/v_proj/o_proj) and MLP (gate_proj/up_proj/down_proj) Linear layers only
training_config.dit_action_head: frozen, untouched (verified via exact weight-sum invariant on every run)

notes: A real bug was found and fixed prior to this run: code/robocasa_lerobot_dataset.py copied the raw lerobot 'action' parquet column directly into the model's action-head input, but the on-disk field order (base_motion, control_mode, ee_position, ee_rotation, gripper_close) does not match the order the model's action head was actually calibrated against (per robocasa.utils.env_utils.convert_action: ee_position, ee_rotation, gripper_close, base_motion, control_mode). This caused an earlier lora_plus_m7_realdata run to collapse to 0.6% overall success. Fixed by adding action_window_to_real_order() to remap the field order before training; verified via a 15/15 (100%) targeted smoke test on CloseFridge/OpenCabinet/NavigateKitchen before launching the full sweep.

Honest headline result: on this run, LoRA+M7 does NOT beat the frozen baseline -- it is essentially tied on atomic_seen (-0.55pt) and modestly behind on composite_seen (-2.63pt), composite_unseen (-0.87pt), and overall (-1.32pt). This file will be updated once lora_only_realdata_fixed completes, which will show whether M7's memory-core term is actively hurting relative to LoRA alone, or whether LoRA alone would show a similar or larger gap versus baseline (in which case M7 isn't the cause of the shortfall).
